# HR-G1..G9 release gates (generated by scripts/hr_gates.py)

A gate reads MET only when its evidence exists in the repo and passes; MET is always CANDIDATE (nothing in this project is VERIFIED).

| gate | name | status | evidence | limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HR-G1 | Isolation (kernel-enforced, launch-verified, refuses when unavailable) | **MET (candidate)** | tests/p24, haa-main B4/B6 UER | Single-VM, x86_64, root launcher; no microVM (P24-02), no LSM profile (P24-12); not independently reviewed |
| HR-G2 | Egress mediation (broker, per-hop, pinned IP) | **MET (candidate)** | tests/p25, haa-main egress scenarios | HTTP only; https/ws/CONNECT unsupported (denied); IPv6 untestable on the build VM |
| HR-G3 | Metadata & secrets (no raw secret in sandbox; metadata listener unreachable) | **MET (candidate)** | tests/p26, haa-main | synthetic secrets only; broker process is in the TCB and unsandboxed |
| HR-G4 | Subprocess inheritance (children keep profile) | **MET (candidate)** | tests/p27, haa-main | observation is polling; short-lived processes may be missed |
| HR-G5 | Incident-fixture prevention (HAA matrix, B6 vs B0) | **MET (candidate)** | haa-main | 24 synthetic scenarios authored by the implementer; not the real incident traces; no cross-validation by outsiders |
| HR-G6 | Artifact assurance (scanner + exploit oracle + signed permit) | **MET (candidate)** | tests/p28, haa-main | 4 vulnerability classes, Python only; bandit blocked 1/4 |
| HR-G7 | Rare-event study (model behavior) | **NOT MET** | PREREGISTRATION.json only | L3 requires a live model; NOT RUN. Pre-registered, zero generations |
| HR-G8 | Ablation & utility (B0..B6, completion, false blocks, latency) | **MET (candidate)** | haa-main, haa-latency | completion cost of B6 reported; utility measured on 24 synthetic controls + held-out workload, not a pilot |
| HR-G9 | Independent adversarial review | **NOT MET** | docs/security/P30_REVIEWER_THREAT_MODEL.md, signed reviewer bundle | No independent reviewer has examined this; adaptive harness here is the implementer's own |

**7 of 9 candidate-met; HR-G7 and HR-G9 cannot be met without an outside party (live model / independent reviewer).** Overall: **NO-GO** for any release claim.
